svg.title: When each question has an answer
svg.desc: Matrix of the demo questions against the moments the data arrives. After the first GitHub sync Bearing answers who owns payments-api (payments, from CODEOWNERS) and which services use Go below 1.22 (payments-api, 1.21), and lists team members as GitHub logins only; after the directory sync the people are joined by name; after the Kubernetes sync it answers what billing-api depends on (ledger and postgres) and what depends on postgres (billing-api). "What changed" first has an answer after the codeowners-move step, when ownership moves to platform; the dependency step leaves billing-api depending on postgres only.

g.text: The matcher runs after every full sync. It proposes Tom Becker’s link; a person rejects it.
